channel.title: Moth & Gravel — Field Notes
channel.description: Curious questions, working answers. Notes from an independent software workbench.

item.title: The picture stays.
item.description: The stream stops. The last position remains. A Coastal watch study in maps, observation age and the confidence a finished picture can borrow.

item.title: A model needs a place.
item.description: A small shrine leaves the modelling bench. Its neighbours bring new questions about looking, choosing and belonging. A SkyStack Builder design study.

item.title: Almost the same.
item.description: Two pictures almost agree. What does the difference tell us, and what does it leave open? A SkyStack Builder study in looking closely.

item.title: A place to stand.
item.description: A pony, a turn of the camera and a place that needs to stay dependable. A SkyStack Builder study in looking and belonging.

item.title: A whole staircase. One undo.
item.description: The player made one thing. Preview, placement and undo should agree about what that thing was. A SkyStack Builder design study.

item.title: Fast signals. Slow eyes.
item.description: A little machine sends numbers. A person needs a place to look. A study in telemetry, freshness and attention from the Kitronik buggy workbench.

item.title: A map should leave room for doubt.
item.description: A little robot, four views and the space it has not established. A study in maps and uncertainty from the Kitronik buggy workbench.

item.title: A green light should mean something.
item.description: Running, passing and delivered: three different questions behind one reassuring colour. A study across the wider workbench.

item.title: A control should stay where you left it.
item.description: A decorative portrait moved the words and Switch control by 72 pixels. A small Decision Docket fix in keeping the work still.

item.title: A metaphor has to earn its place.
item.description: River, Circle and Focus: how an expressive interface helps someone recover context and continue the work. A Decision Docket design study.

item.title: Afterlight / Nightfall.
item.description: A practical study in bone, charcoal and brass—and what an expressive identity owes to legible interfaces.

item.title: Curiosity with calluses.
item.description: Two unlikely words. One independent studio. Why strange ideas still need to hold up in the real world.
